summary: Audited 2,000 MCQs in waves 9-12 against the locked 0264 whitelist/blacklist. 28 items REJECT_SYLLABUS and 1,972 SYL_PASS. Dominant violations: gearing (15, expressly forbidden in 5.1), inventory/stock turnover (6), payables/receivables days (3), payback period (2), zero-hours contract (1) and named Friedman/Freeman shareholder/stakeholder ethical theory (1). Manifest cross-check: all 14 U5 + 1 U6 gearing flags, both payables-days flags, the receivables-days flag and the payback flag were confirmed; three newly discovered items were added (stock turnover 371, payback 440, zero-hours 328) plus one beyond-whitelist ethical-theory item (838). Manifest flags for bare 'conglomerate' (747/420/743) and 'buffer inventory' (509) were verified as false positives against the locked terms 'conglomerate integration' and 'buffer inventory formula' (no formula/teaching present), so those items pass. Duplicate-stem flags were excluded as non-syllabus issues; arithmetic and explanation quality were not assessed.
